children: Xylem entered a new senior unsecured five-year revolving credit facility for up to $1.5 billion, expandable to $2.0 billion, and simultaneously terminated its March 1, 2023 $1.0 billion revolver. The new multi-currency facility (USD and EUR) features interest based on a base rate or Term SOFR/EURIBOR plus a margin linked to Xylem’s credit rating and a sustainability adjustment, and includes customary leverage covenants. No borrowings were outstanding at closing. The termination appears to be an early replacement with no disclosed fees, enhancing liquidity and aligning terms with sustainability-linked pricing.
: Citibank, JPMorgan Chase Bank, BNP Paribas, ING, Wells Fargo and other lenders
: Enhance liquidity for working capital and general corporate purposes
: Replaced by larger 2026 revolving credit facility
